text.p: AMRE Inc said Friday it was discussing possible financing strategies with several groups, including HFS Inc, and expects to finalize any financing transactions in the fourth quarter.
AMRE said it had hired Bear Stearns & Co Inc as an adviser for the transaction, which would involve either debt or equity.
Any transaction would be designed to provide the company with enough cash to meet anticipated working needs, it said.

AMRE said there are no assurances it can complete a financing transaction or otherwise maintain liquidity. If it fails to do so, it would have a "material adverse effect" on its overall financial condition, AMRE said.
HFS has hired Merrill Lynch & Co to serve as a financial adviser and is committed to assisting AMRE in finding a solution to its working capital needs, AMRE said.
